title: Substituted rows share slot-scoped data-testids, breaking the pinned-testid contract the story itself relies on
detail: Rows are keyed by call_id but every testid is slot-scoped (refcheck-row/overflow/menu/action-*-<slot>). Substitution renders two rows per slot, so all ids duplicate and selectors hit the first match.
recommended_fix: Suffix interactive testids with the call id (e.g. refcheck-overflow-<slot>-<call_id>), or strip the retained history row's interactive ids once a live successor exists.

title: Substitute affordance stays live on the retained history row and completes as a 200 no-op with a success toast
detail: Spec: "re-substituting the old terminal row (kept as history) is a 200 no-op with no duplicate audit". The client still renders Substitute on the history row and toasts "Referee substituted - the new invitation is on its way." when nothing was sent.
recommended_fix: Server: clear can_substitute_referee on a terminal row whose slot already has a live successor; client: surface the returned successor id instead of a success toast.

title: Taken-over rows drop the overflow menu but keep the body substitute surface — automation can be silently re-armed
detail: A taken-over unreachable row shows "You're handling this one" + export and a working Substitute button (hook-gated only); substituting creates a queued row the sweep picks up, contradicting the takeover's automation-stops promise.
recommended_fix: Gate the body substitute surface on not taken_over too, or deliberately support substitute-on-taken-over and pin it with a test.

title: Server action errors toast instead of rendering inline in the §8.3 edit-trio, contrary to the story's own spec
detail: Spec item 10: "error states stay inline (brand copy)". Only client-side validation errors land in edit.error; server errors (409/422) surface as CtxRefcheckAction toasts, so the inline error slot stays unused.
recommended_fix: For correct/substitute failures, map the mapped error into the row's RefcheckEdit.error field and keep the toast for non-edit actions.

title: UserDismissedRefcheckAction ignores its call_id, and a confirm orphaned by a sweep transition stays live invisibly
detail: If the sweep advances a queued row while its start confirm is open, the confirm stops rendering (row arm changed) but remains in the model; only another row's dismiss or route change clears it.
recommended_fix: Match call_id as UserConfirmedRefcheckAction does, and drop the confirm when the owning row's status no longer renders a confirm surface.
